description: This file implements the DataService class for a modem simulator, handling various AT commands related to PDP contexts, data activation, and network configuration. It manages PDP context states, processes commands for setting and querying PDP contexts, and simulates network responses.

classes.name: DataService
classes.description: A class that simulates a modem data service, handling AT commands for PDP context management, data activation, and network configuration.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes and returns a list of command handlers for various AT commands related to data service.

methods.name: InitializeServiceState
methods.description: Initializes the internal state of the data service, such as data connection configurations.

methods.name: HandleActivateDataCall
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGACT command to activate or deactivate a PDP context.

methods.name: HandleQueryDataCallList
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGACT? command to query the list of active PDP contexts.

methods.name: HandlePDPContext
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGDCONT command to set PDP context parameters.

methods.name: HandleQueryPDPContextList
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGDCONT? command to query configured PDP contexts.

methods.name: HandleEnterDataState
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGDATA command to establish data connection.

methods.name: HandleReadDynamicParam
methods.description: Handles the AT+CGCONTRDP command to read dynamic parameters of a PDP context.

methods.name: sendOnePhysChanCfgUpdate
methods.description: Sends an unsolicited update about physical channel configuration.

methods.name: onUpdatePhysicalChannelconfigs
methods.description: Triggers an update of physical channel configurations based on modem technology and frequency.

methods.name: updatePhysicalChannelconfigs
methods.description: Updates physical channel configurations for active PDP contexts and schedules repeated updates.
